purpose: Academic style/profile resolver for Portuguese-language users. These records identify style families and source authorities; they are not a substitute for current official rules or institution/journal instructions.

profiles.scope: Brazilian standards and institution-specific academic manuals
profiles.notes: Do not infer a current ABNT rule from memory. Institution manuals may specify how ABNT standards are applied and may add local requirements.
Use current APA Style guidance or user/institution instructions for detailed formatting.
Vancouver is a family of biomedical reference conventions; journal-specific author instructions may override or refine details.
Resolve the target publication's current author instructions before asserting submission details.
Resolve whether notes-bibliography or author-date applies.
Use current MLA guidance and institution/course instructions.
Target journal instructions may add or override submission details.

profiles.scope: Institution-specific author-date systems commonly labeled Harvard
profiles.authority_name: Institution or publisher using the named Harvard variant
profiles.notes: There is no single universal Harvard standard. Require the institution, publisher, journal, course or supplied guide before asserting exact formatting.

conflict_rule: When two applicable sources disagree, surface CONFLICTING RULES and identify which source has the more specific governing authority. Do not silently combine styles.
unknown_rule: If the governing profile/version or source cannot be established, output Perfil/norma aplicável: UNKNOWN / EVIDENCE MISSING.
